newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sankyo to expand sales of diabetes drug in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Sankyo to expand sales of diabetes drug in Europe.

text.p: Japanese pharmaceutical firm Sankyo Co Ltd said on Friday it plans to expand sales of its diabetes drug, Noscal, to the European continent after a planned launch in Britain by the end of this year, pending approval from the British authorities.
Sankyo applied to the British authorities in March for permission to market the drug.
Sankyo plans to double the number of marketing staff at its wholly-owned German subsidiary to 150, a company spokesman said, although no time schedule for the staff expansion had been set.
Noscal has been sold in the U.S. and Japanese markets since March.
The company expects U.S. shipments of the drug to total 3.8 billion yen in the 1997/98 business year, the spokesman said.
